sources.source: Hugging Face Tokenizers documentation and repository
sources.projection: Tokenization is produced by a concrete tokenizer pipeline/model and its preprocessing/postprocessing configuration rather than being an intrinsic model-independent property of text.
rakl_mapping: token count authority is scoped to an executed counter implementation/revision
do not promote declared token metadata to exact model budget authority
sources.novelty_effect: tokenizer-specific counting is established infrastructure, not RAKL novelty

sources.projection: Some tokenizer behavior includes model-specific settings beyond a generic tokenizer artifact.
rakl_mapping: model/tokenizer compatibility is a scoped relation and may remain partially identified for hosted providers
sources.novelty_effect: narrows any claim of universal token counting

sources.projection: Build provenance identifies output subjects and build context so consumers can verify artifacts against expectations; cryptographic digests are central artifact identities.
rakl_mapping: release manifest binds exact artifact bytes now while richer builder/material provenance remains a separate future layer
artifact provenance does not mint scientific truth
sources.novelty_effect: artifact-digest provenance is established supply-chain practice

sources.source: Python Packaging User Guide wheel/binary-distribution specification
sources.projection: Wheel is a standardized Python binary distribution format with explicit distribution metadata and compatibility semantics.
rakl_mapping: publication release identity should bind the exact built wheel rather than only source files
sources.novelty_effect: Python distribution formats are standards, not RAKL novelty

sources.source: Python Packaging User Guide reproducible-environments specifications
sources.projection: Package/environment selection needs explicit, reproducible dependency identities rather than whatever is available at execution time.
rakl_mapping: reinforces evaluator dependency pinning and future release dependency manifests
sources.novelty_effect: reproducible dependency/environment specifications are prior art

remaining_rakl_specific_question: Whether scoped token/artifact authority integrated with RAKL's context compiler, execution receipts and scientific authority separation improves reproducibility/error localization relative to common agent-research packaging practices.
